barrier.definitions: A=sup X0**2; B=sup Y0**2>0; L=sup |(Y0**2)prime|; M=integral(X0**2+Y0**2)

bounds.backward: reflect x and reverse t, exchanging sigma; same initial norm constants

scope: All smooth real phase-locked finite-charge bounded initial data with bounded derivatives on R, both time directions, zeros allowed. Small complex perturbations of compact reference profiles in fixed support are also global; unrestricted complex data and genuine transverse dynamics remain open. No source physical parity/domain conclusion.

complex_neighborhood.conclusion: global arbitrary-phase solution and exact scattering; open relative to fixed-support smooth data

scattering: For compact initial support in [l,r], exact free transport after |t|>(r-l)/2; no smallness condition in the phase-locked class.
